description: This file implements functions for converting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses from binary to presentation format, including inet_ntop4, inet_ntop6, and inet_ntop, with support for IPv6 shorthanding.

methods.name: inet_ntop4
methods.description: Formats an IPv4 address from binary to dotted decimal string.

methods.name: inet_ntop6
methods.description: Formats an IPv6 address from binary to compressed hexadecimal string with optional IPv4 embedding.

methods.name: inet_ntop
methods.description: Converts a network address (IPv4 or IPv6) to presentation format, dispatching to inet_ntop4 or inet_ntop6.
